learning_and_improvements_registry.author: Antigravity Quality Assurance & AI Engineering Team

improvements.title: Ambiguous queries falling back to generic RAG instead of requesting clarification
affected_queries: Can you check my employee profile?
improvements.initial_behavior: When users asked bare questions like 'Where is my shipment?' without an ID, the classifier routed to GENERAL_FAQ or broad RAG. The system attempted broad vector searches and LLM generation, frequently returning irrelevant answers or failing when offline.
improvements.root_cause: The LogisticsIntent enum lacked an explicit CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED intent. Ambiguous short queries lacked regex patterns to detect missing identifiers, causing the bot to bypass the fast clarification path.

changes: Implemented pattern matching for bare tracking, fee, hub, and employee queries missing required identifiers.
Added dedicated clarification handling block (Section 4b) in chatbot/bot.py returning prompt with valid ID formats (e.g. SHP-10001 or EMP-20001).

improvements.title: Offline RAG knowledge synthesis when external Groq LLM API is disconnected
affected_queries: What is the standard procedure for handling damaged shipments?
Summarize the cold-chain pharmaceutical cargo policy.
What are the dangerous goods handling rules?
improvements.initial_behavior: When the sandbox or environment lacked external network access to the Groq API, the LLM client raised LLMUnavailableError or connection retry loops. The chatbot returned a generic message: 'The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.', ignoring the highly relevant knowledge chunks retrieved from ChromaDB.
improvements.root_cause: chatbot/bot.py relied strictly on external LLM inference to format knowledge context. It lacked a local, deterministic fallback to synthesize retrieved ChromaDB knowledge articles when the LLM connection fails.

changes: Enhanced Step 8 in chatbot/bot.py to detect when LLM inference is offline or unavailable.
Implemented an offline knowledge synthesis engine that extracts key policy statements, standards, and action points directly from context.knowledge_articles.
Attaches structured document citations, document codes, and confidence indicators.

improvements.title: ChromaDB relative path resolved incorrectly when executed outside project root
affected_queries: All RAG queries executed from workspace root or subdirectories
improvements.initial_behavior: CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY was defined as a relative string 'data/chroma_db'. When tests or scripts ran from the parent directory, ChromaDB initialized an empty new vector store at <parent>/data/chroma_db with 0 chunks instead of reading the 822 pre-indexed chunks.
improvements.root_cause: Path definition in src/logistics_chatbot/core/config.py was not anchored to PROJECT_ROOT.

changes: Updated CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY = PROJECT_ROOT / 'data' / 'chroma_db' ensuring absolute path resolution regardless of working directory.

improvements.title: Hugging Face Hub DNS retry timeouts during SentenceTransformers cold-start
improvements.initial_behavior: SentenceTransformers attempted to check huggingface.co on model load, resulting in 5 consecutive getaddrinfo failures with exponential backoff (~25s delay on startup in sandboxed environments).
improvements.root_cause: The environment was running sandboxed without HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE environment variables set.

changes: Set os.environ['HF_HUB_OFFLINE'] = '1' and os.environ['TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE'] = '1' in config.py prior to importing transformers or sentence_transformers.

retest_results.cold_start_delay: Reduced from ~25s to 0.4s using local cached commit hash

improvements.title: Deterministic schema and consistency verification across 10,000 production records
affected_queries: All Category 8 data validation queries (VAL_001 through VAL_015)
improvements.initial_behavior: Chatbot needed to accurately answer deep structural queries regarding missing delivery dates, invalid statuses, duplicate records, foreign key referential integrity, and location validity across the 10,000 shipment dataset without hallucinating.
improvements.root_cause: Lack of an automated validation harness to audit shipments.db and provide verified ground truth for data integrity test cases.

changes: Built a comprehensive read-only data validator testing all 10,000 shipments, 500 employees, 100 customer accounts, and 10 global hubs.
Audited required fields, foreign key references, geographic coordinates, delivery date chronology, and status enumeration.
Generated tests/reports/data_validation_report.json confirming 100% schema integrity and 0 orphaned records.

continuous_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Deploy a local quantized small language model (e.g., Llama-3-8B-Instruct or Qwen-2.5-7B quantized via GGUF/llama.cpp) as an on-premises offline fallback for rich generative synthesis when cloud API connectivity is interrupted.
continuous_improvement_recommendations.expected_impact: Provides generative answer synthesis even in strict air-gapped network environments without relying on cloud APIs.

continuous_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Implement an automated cron or schedule job to execute the 174-question regression test suite nightly and whenever a new knowledge document is uploaded.
continuous_improvement_recommendations.expected_impact: Prevents regression in document retrieval precision and verifies newly ingested SOPs immediately.

continuous_improvement_recommendations.recommendation: Expand multi-turn contextual tracking to maintain a sliding-window session state across complex multi-shipment comparative workflows.
continuous_improvement_recommendations.expected_impact: Enables operators to compare transit legs across 3 or more shipments concurrently in conversational turns.
